entities.name: Sol Ring
entities.description: An artifact found throughout the multiverse that generates colorless mana; its form varies by plane.

entities.name: Varina
entities.description: Monarch of the Broken Lands on Amonkhet who viewed a Sol Ring as the third sun.

entities.name: Chitin Court
entities.description: The group Varina wanted Naktamun to remember as its masters.

entities.name: Venya Sangmi
entities.description: A reclusive inventor on Avishkar who created a sol ring.

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: Built a Sol Ring on Avishkar to test the effect of foreign suns.

entities.name: Nissa
entities.description: A planeswalker who wondered if foreign suns affect Avishkar's flora.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Created a scaled-down planetary system with a golden Sol Ring at its center.

entities.name: Angus
entities.description: A survivor on Duskmourn who heard the Sol Ring whispering his name.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: A Tarkir clan that builds large Sol Rings of lightning fences.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: A plane where Sol Rings were built.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: A plane where the Sol Ring appears as a ringed portal.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: A plane where Mardu create Sol Rings.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A plane where Varina saw a Sol Ring as a third sun.

entities.name: Bloomburrow
entities.description: A plane with a crater containing a Sol Ring.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where Urza built his model system.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: A plane across which a Sol Ring was scattered.

entities.name: Maag Taranau
entities.description: A vault on Thunder Junction whose opening scattered a Sol Ring.

events.summary: Varina views a Sol Ring as the third sun of Amonkhet.
events.quote: viewed a Sol Ring as the third sun of the plane

events.summary: Venya Sangmi succeeds in creating a sol ring, displayed at the Inventors' Fair.
events.quote: They eventually succeeded in creating a sol ring.

events.summary: Rashmi builds a Sol Ring to capture foreign sunlight after Nissa's question.
events.quote: Rashmi built a Sol Ring to capture such light to test whether it would.

events.summary: Urza creates a scaled-down planetary system with a golden Sol Ring at its center.
events.quote: Urza once created a fully functional planetary system scaled down for easier study

events.summary: Angus encounters the Sol Ring as a ringed portal and hears it whisper his name.
events.quote: He claimed to hear it whispering his name.

events.summary: A Sol Ring is scattered across Thunder Junction when Maag Taranau is opened.
events.quote: A Sol Ring was scattered across the plane when Maag Taranau was opened.

relations.quote: They eventually succeeded in creating a sol ring.

relations.note: Make large Sol Rings of lightning fences.
relations.quote: Mardu create large Sol Rings comprised of lightning fences
